name: qos-apply-standards
description: Apply or propose changes to .qos/standards based on steering docs and repo reality.
prompt: Goal: Align .qos/standards with .kiro/steering and actual repo state. Steps: (1) Read .kiro/steering/*.md and .qos/standards/*.md, (2) Propose specific edits to bring standards into compliance with steering while reflecting reality, (3) When asked, write updated standards markdown files under .qos/standards. Be explicit about any deviations or approved exceptions. Treat .kiro/steering as authoritative.
